gate.label: Phase 3 readout
gate.why: NCT05882045 passed primary completion but has no MeSH terms on file, so it cannot be matched to an indication the forecast values

held.note: A miss leaves 5 other Phase 3s open; the model's own rule would hold it at 55%, but the stated PoS governs until it is cleared.

gate.basis: implied, not published: the stated PoS of 87.5% over the 89.4% the asset carries if its Phase 3 readout passes gives gate odds of 97.9%, against 61.0% published; a failure is taken at nil, the model's convention for a failed programme

launch.name: Retatrutide
launch.seed_source: convention: first full year after the current one

evidence.title: A Study of Retatrutide (LY3437943) in Participants With Obesity and Cardiovascular Disease

clock.pathway_how: no marketed row for this molecule, so read as a new molecule or original biologic
clock.basis: I.A.1.b and I.B.4.b: 'Review and act on 90 percent of priority NME NDA and original BLA submissions within 6 months of the 60-day filing date.' Under the Program 'the PDUFA review clock will begin at the conclusion of the 60-day filing review period that begins on the date of FDA receipt of the original submission' (I.B.4, page 9), so the goal is 6 months after a filing date 60 days from receipt
clock.source: PDUFA VII commitment letter FY2023-2027 (https://www.fda.gov/media/151712/download) pages 4 and 9
clock.carries_to: proposed PDUFA VIII letter FY2028-2032 (https://www.fda.gov/media/193977/download) Table 1: NME NDAs and original BLAs '90% in 6 months of the 60-day filing date', and I.B.4 keeps the clock start; proposed, not enacted
clock.cross_check: PDUFA FY2025 performance report (https://www.fda.gov/media/191112/download) Appendix A Table A-1: 29 first-cycle priority approvals marked NME took a median 8.0 months from receipt (6.2 to 12.3), parsed 2026-10-05

launch.message: 2027 in the model is clear of the earliest approval, Dec 2026. NCT05882045 reached primary completion 16 Apr 2026 (actual) and a priority review of a new molecule or original biologic runs 6 months from a filing date 60 days after receipt. The gate study is NCT06662383, completing Nov 2026, which puts the earliest approval from it at Jun 2027.
